name: Atlassian
summary: Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Bitbucket and Compass, with Rovo as the AI layer and the Jira Service Management virtual service agent, which automates Tier 1 support (intents, AI answers from the knowledge base, automated actions such as software access and password resets) across Slack, Teams, email and the portal. For agents, the vendor publishes the Atlassian Rovo MCP Server at mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp, which reads and writes work across those products plus Loom, Teams, Goals and Projects; OAuth 2.1, or an API token where an admin enables it; measured 401 with no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-15, no credentials: MCP initialize at mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp answers 401 with a Bearer challenge naming its protected-resource metadata, which answers 200 and names auth.atlassian.com. The v1 endpoints still answer 401. Vendor: OAuth 2.1 with the user's own permissions.

jobs.summary: Jira Service Management virtual service agent, the vendor's words: "automating Tier 1 support issues", "automating common actions like software access or password resets", AI answers from the knowledge base, help without having to "wait for a human agent". Premium and Enterprise plans. Not measured.
